phasepro.citation: Mészáros et al. 2020 Nucleic Acids Res. 48:D360–D367
phasepro.license_note: Public JSON dump of curated LLPS-driver entries (UniProt accession keys). Redistribute UniProt ID list with citation; do not claim PhaSePro curation.

llpsdb.citation: Li et al. 2020 Nucleic Acids Res. 48:D320–D327; LLPSDB v2 (2021)
llpsdb.license_note: Free download of unambiguous phase-separation protein.xls from LLPSDB v2. We deposit UniProt accessions only (not sequences or full XLS).

drllps_experimental.citation: Ning et al. 2020 Nucleic Acids Res. 48:D288–D295
drllps_experimental.license_note: Download page TXT of experimentally identified LLPS-associated proteins (~9.2k rows with UniProt IDs). Free for academic use; cite DrLLPS.

drllps_vitis.citation: Ning et al. 2020 Nucleic Acids Res. 48:D288–D295
drllps_vitis.license_note: Species FASTA of DrLLPS ortholog-expanded Vitis entries (gene IDs, not UniProt). We deposit gene-symbol list only; raw FASTA stays in gitignored cache.

cdcode.citation: Rostam et al. 2023 Nat Methods (CD-CODE); Hadarovich et al. 2025 NAR (CD-CODE 2.0); Edmond dump doi:10.17617/3.WDM3PG
cdcode.license_note: CD-CODE dumps are CC BY-NC 4.0. We deposit UniProt accession lists extracted from protein2cdcode / protein CSV for cross-annotation only — not the full dump. Commercial redistribution of CD-CODE content requires their license terms.
